title: Rural Sawmill Operation, Smokestack & Timber - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing an active rural sawmill in operation amidst a wooded clearing. The industrial setup features an open-sided shelter topped with corrugated metal roofing, housing stacks of freshly cut timber and boards. A prominent mound of sawdust rests to the left, while a tall central smokestack rises into the sky and white steam or smoke vents actively from the right section, illustrating early-to-mid 20th-century steam-powered lumber processing.
